soldier: Head brownish yellow, pronotum dull yellow. The head bears short hairs, slightly denser anteriorly. Head capsule rectangular, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle a small round dot, slightly raised. Labrum broadly ligulate, widest before the midpoint, wider than long. Mandibles stout and straight, the apices slightly curved, the ridge-like swelling at the mandibular base indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented. The waist region of the postmentum is narrow and long, the postmentum about 2.8–2.9 times as long as wide and about 7.47–7.58 times the narrowest part of the waist region. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about twice as wide as long, the anterior margin deeply concave in a broad V, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in a broad arc, the posterior margin slightly concave at the centre, the median area with about 10 hairs.
